mentions.name: AI Safety Cookie Clicker
mentions.description: This is a cookie clicker style web game secretly about AI safety. It aims to be fun while letting players experience why an AI might do unexpected things, such as pursuing instrumental goals like collecting resources or refusing to be turned off. It currently has two endings, with more being added.
